stratagems.effect: Its TORRENT attacks get +1 Attacks, or +2 Attacks against PSYKER or Battle-shocked targets.

armyRules.name: Martial Ka'tah
armyRules.text: At the start of your Command phase, friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES units with this ability become readied. Each readied unit can use one ka'tah in your Command phase, then stops being readied. Ka'tahs: Conservai, Calistus, Salvus, Dacatarai, Kaptaris, Rendax. Shield Host detachments give a Favoured Ka'tah with an extra effect.

armyRules.name: Aegis of the Emperor
armyRules.text: Friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES units with this ability have Feel No Pain 5+ against mortal wounds.

armyRules.name: Aquila Commander
armyRules.text: At the start of each battle round, if this model is your WARLORD, gain 1CP.

armyRules.name: Daughters of the Abyss
armyRules.text: Friendly ANATHEMA PSYKANA units with this ability have Feel No Pain 3+ against Psychic Attacks and Psychic Null (Aura): friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES units within 6" have Feel No Pain 5+ against Psychic Attacks.

armyRules.name: Special Move Types
armyRules.text: Shock Disembark: units embarked in a TRANSPORT on the battlefield that did not embark this phase can set up within 3" of it. They cannot declare charges that turn.
